content:
jasper: FYI onboarding Nimbus (acct 123456789012) — they need p5 + g5 footprint in eu-south-3 and ap-south-2. I'm starting the AWS quota requests but need help with ENI/IPv4 pool and a quick cost justification for support. Details below.

samir: Can you paste the exact instance types and counts?

jasper: Target: p5.24xlarge x6 in eu-south-3, g5.48xlarge x4 in eu-south-3; p5.24xlarge x2 in ap-south-2 for burst. Also need Elastic Fabric Adapter support for p5 in those regions.

marie: Account alias? reply with AWS account id

jasper: Account: 123456789012, org unit: customers/onboard. Project tag: owner=solutions, project=nimbus

kevin: I'll open the AWS case. Use Service Quotas -> EC2 -> "Running On-Demand G instances" and "Running On-Demand P instances" quotas. Also need "VPC Elastic Network Interfaces per region" bump to 5000 and "IPv4 addresses per subnet" guidance — maybe request extra ENI quota and request additional private IPv4 pool. I'll attach this justification:

```Justification:
Nimbus is a paid enterprise pilot requiring reserved capacity for inference. Expected steady-state sustained throughput needs 85 GPU-hours/day in eu-south-3 and 30 GPU-hours/day in ap-south-2. This workload is latency-sensitive; we require dedicated p5/g5 capacity and increased ENI limits for multi-node launches. Redwood Inference will commit to a 6-month billing minimum for reserved capacity in these regions.
```

infra-bot: Case opened (CASE-987654321). AWS estimated response 24-48h. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#CASE-987654321

samir: Ping once they ask for ARNs, we need to provide role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodQuotaRequester

marie: Also double-check subnets: we need /20 or bigger for node scale. Which VPC?

jasper: VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d, subnets: subnet-eu1 (10.10.0.0/20), subnet-eu2 (10.11.0.0/20). If AWS pushes back on IPs we'll request larger mask.

kevin: Cost note: projected monthly spend ~ $280k at on-demand; propose committed reserved capacity to lower to ~$160k. Flagging finance for approval.

emma: noted — need the 6-month ARR estimate and contract copy before approving.

jasper: Thanks — I'll draft the contract terms and upload.

samir: If AWS stalls, escalate with account manager; I've DM'd them.

aws-support: Support update: we've approved ENI increase to 5000 for eu-south-3 and ap-south-2; p5/g5 quotas pending, we need region availability confirmation from internal capacity team.

jasper: Great — will follow up. /cc @kevin @marie :thumbsup:
